name: 10AN to 1 1/16 - 12 SAE
title: 10AN to 1 1/16 - 12 SAE
description:
The 10AN to 1 1/16 - 12 SAE is a high-performance component engineered for demanding automotive applications. Founded in 2008, ColorFittings is an industry leader in premium automotive, marine, and aviation plumbing products.

Whether you’re a professional building a 6-second NHRA bracket car, a perfectionist designing the ultimate engine bay for a SEMA car, or an HPDE enthusiast looking to improve your oil temps, their products are designed for all flavors of motorsports.

ColorFittings products are carefully machined from 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum and finished with their proprietary polish and anodizing process.

Available in unique gloss-finish colors, these AN Fittings are specifically designed for use with high-quality PTFE hose.

AN Hose applications pair excellently with their lightweight Hose Separators, which are available in unique gloss-finish colors.

For a hassle-free installation process, the manufacturer strongly recommend using their Fitting Assembly Tools.

Technical Specifications:
• Construction: Precision machined for rigorous track and street applications.
